dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hello! Welcome to Kiminami Restaurant, the first and last stop for gourmet culture in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I get some food to go?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Take your pick — I'm very proud of each and every one of these.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: This is Kiminami Restaurant. I, the future owner Kiminami Anna, run the place right now. Our restaurant has inherited the cooking skills of the royal head chef of the Shogunate. You could even say that we are the face of fine Inazuman cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But let me just preface everything by saying that we've been short-staffed ever since my father disappeared, so you'll have to wait for a while if you wish to dine-in. We have lemon water with unlimited refills available in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Come back next time! I'll be even better then.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hello, you must be Miss Kamisato's friend! Come in! Would you like to try the new dish that I just learned?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I get some food to go?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I have already learned the recipe you gave me previously, and I've added it to the menu. Otherwise, take your pick.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I have learned some new recipes since we last met. The new products I made have even been approved by my mom.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Once my cooking skills are as good as my grandpa's were back when he was working as the royal head chef of the Shogunate, I will probably be able to take over this restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: My father will be stunned when he gets back, oh yes he will, indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Oh right, you can also invite Miss Kamisato here too. If it's you asking, I think she will definitely agree to come, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Come back soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your father...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I suppose I should start from the beginning here... A long time ago, my father came to Inazuma as a foreign gourmet foodie. He was very impressed by the local culinary scene, so he volunteered to be a kitchen assistant at this restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Later on, my father married into the Kiminami Clan. After my grandfather had been called by the Shogunate to become the head chef, he and my mom started to run Kiminami Restaurant together.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I've been learning how to cook since I was little. I was supposed to take over Kiminami Restaurant when they retired. But my father suddenly disappeared last year without leaving a trace.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: That's how I started cooking in the restaurant to help my mom.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hmm... Although I've learned a lot, I'm still far from being on grandpa's level. I have to become better still if I want to take over this restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: If you have any feedback for me after trying out the food here, please don't hesitate to let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: *sigh* What am I to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler? Great, you have perfect timing!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Do you remember the recipe you wrote for me the last time, when you and Ms. Kamisato came to my store?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, that pizza was so popular that many customers came to the store to order it specially.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But... some customers also said that they were bored of eating this pizza all the time and asked if I have other pizza flavors.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Although I have tried several methods to make new types of pizza based on feedback from customers...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But I always feel... that something is lacking, and the response from customers is not very good.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I'm really not good at making pizza...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, you know a lot about this dish, right? Can you give me some advice?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Great! By the way, I've also collected feedback from customers. Give me a moment, I'll look for it.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Miss Rie said that although the taste of this pizza is not bad...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: But she felt that the pizza would taste better if it incorporated some of Inazuma's local ingredients.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: I wonder what ingredients she would like to see... Traveler, please help me ask her.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Do you want to take a look at the customer feedback?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Give me a moment, I'll look for it.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Miss Matsumoto said that although the pizza in my shop incorporates a lot of ingredients from Inazuma, she heard that Mondstadt pizza is not made like this.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: She said that for such outland delicacies, it's better to retain it's authentic flavor...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: *sigh* But how am I going to know how to make Mondstadt's pizza? Traveler, please help me ask her.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Do you want to take a look at the customer feedback?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Give me a moment, I'll look for it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May your culinary arts become more and more refined.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, thanks~

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: That reminds me, I got some fresh fish today. Please try the fresh tuna sushi! I made it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: If you have any suggestions, feel free to tell me. After all, suggestions go hand in hand with improvement.
